criteria: Observe and pin actual upstream default source, compare the precise null-guard seam with the original baseline, and inspect relevant history and existing work.
Identify the shipping linked-source assembly and all located key-type instantiations and real producers; distinguish TValue structs from TKey structs and source cardinality from deployment frequency.
Explain reference, non-nullable value, and nullable-value null semantics without treating annotation constraints or IL box instructions as allocation proof.
Any native/build/test process requires actual F214 registration, an active untimed preparation scope, and an immediately preceding actual HOLD/lease check.
Prefer existing canonical unit/producer tests if authorized; optional JIT inspection must be untimed, bounded, and preserve optimization settings, with no warmup or benchmark-like loop.
Propose a private shipping candidate only after establishing a genuine surviving runtime problem and a faithful producer; otherwise preserve source and report a precise no-candidate rationale.
Persist exact source identities, caller evidence, diagnostic/test commands and exits, a changed-file diff/hash index, and runtime/performance limitations; leave all owned native work terminal.
excluded: Timing, allocation counters, benchmarks, profiles, performance comparisons, publication, and final coordinator disposition.
Unrelated finding scopes, reserved-checkout writes, policy/lease/registry/ledger changes, public API/default/convention changes, and dependency configuration edits.
Production reachability inferred from a synthetic value-key call.
Claims about unexecuted runtimes, deployment key distributions, NativeAOT, Mono, or WebAssembly.
